turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Hey Leo! Happy Sunday. How's your weekend going in Austin?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hey! It's going pretty well, thanks. Just having a really lazy Sunday morning. I'm currently lounging around in an oversized hoodie, listening to some music.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: That sounds like the perfect way to spend a Sunday morning. Have you had your morning coffee yet, or are you still sticking to the doctor's advice about cutting back on caffeine?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I am! I actually just made a matcha latte. It's a nice change of pace and definitely keeps the caffeine levels a bit lower like the doctor suggested.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Good for you! Matcha is a great alternative. Speaking of upcoming things, how are the preparations going for your sister Ana's wedding in November? It's getting pretty close!

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Oh, it really is! November is right around the corner. Ana is a bit stressed, but everything is coming together. I've been practicing some songs on my guitar in case they want me to play something casual, but mostly I'm just getting my suit ready.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: That's wonderful that you might play some guitar for them! I'm sure she appreciates having you there to help. Are you planning on doing any rock climbing today, or is it strictly a rest day?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Definitely a rest day today. My arms are still pretty sore from climbing on Friday. I'm just taking it easy, and I actually just finished making a homemade salad for lunch.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: A homemade salad sounds like a perfect light Sunday lunch, especially for a rest day. Did you put anything special in it?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Just some mixed greens, cucumbers, tomatoes, and a quick vinaigrette. Simple and fresh. Sam is out for the day, so it's just nice and quiet here.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Sounds lovely. A peaceful house is always nice. How are things looking for the upcoming week at the logistics firm? Ready for the Monday grind as an account coordinator?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Honestly, as ready as I can be! We have a couple of big shipments scheduled, so it'll probably be a busy week, but I'm trying not to think about work until tomorrow. For now, I'm just going to enjoy the rest of my Sunday.
